units.source_text: 内大臣本想把她送交弘徽殿女御，此时又觉不妥。

en.t: The Minister of the Interior had originally meant to hand her over to the Kokiden Consort, but now he felt that would not do.

units.source_text: 他想：“女御虽然是我亲生女儿，但她品貌优越，令人敬佩。

en.t: He thought, "Although the consort is my own daughter, her bearing and beauty are so exceptional that one cannot help admiring her.

units.source_text: 我把这样的一个人交付给她，也有些不好意思。

en.t: I would feel rather ashamed to entrust someone like this to her care.

units.source_text: 她一定会笑我：‘父亲究竟是什么主意，这样古怪的一个人，也不打听打听清楚，贸然地接了她进来。’

en.t: She would surely laugh at me and say, 'What can Father be thinking, bringing in such a strange person so rashly without first finding out more about her?'

units.source_text: 况且女御身边侍女甚多，她们看到了她的怪相，一定到处宣传开去。”

en.t: Besides, the consort has many ladies-in-waiting around her; once they saw the woman's odd appearance, they would certainly spread the story everywhere."

units.source_text: 便对近江君说：“女御这几天正好归宁在家。

en.t: So he said to Omi no Kimi, "The consort happens to be back at her family home for these few days.

units.source_text: 你不妨常去望她，学学别人的榜样。

en.t: You should go visit her often and learn a little from the example of others.

units.source_text: 寻常凡庸之人，多多与人交往，学些好样，自然也能成品。

en.t: Even ordinary, mediocre people can naturally become presentable if they associate with others often and learn good models.

units.source_text: 你也应该如此用心，多多和她亲近。”

en.t: You too should apply yourself in that way and spend more time close to her."

units.source_text: 近江君说：“若能如此，我真是高兴极了！

en.t: Omi no Kimi said, "If I can do that, I will be truly overjoyed!

units.source_text: 我多年以来，东想办法，西想办法，一心只想大家承认我这个人。

en.t: For many years I have tried every possible way, thinking only of having everyone acknowledge me as someone who matters.

units.source_text: 我白天也这样想，晚上做梦也这样想，此外什么事情也不想。

en.t: I think of it by day, dream of it by night, and think of nothing else at all.

units.source_text: 爹爹允许我亲近这位大姐，叫我替她汲水我也高兴。”

en.t: If Father permits me to be near this elder sister, I would be happy even if she told me to draw water for her."

units.source_text: 她得意之极，说话更像鸟啭一般快速了。

en.t: She was beside herself with delight, and her speech grew even faster, like a bird's twittering.

units.source_text: 内大臣觉得毫无办法，对她说道：“不须你亲自汲水或拾薪，也可去见女御。

en.t: The Minister of the Interior felt there was nothing to be done and said to her, "You may go see the consort without personally drawing water or gathering firewood.

units.source_text: 但求你远离你所肖似的那个老和尚。”

en.t: Only, I beg you to keep far away from that old monk whom you so closely resemble."

units.source_text: 这种幽默的讽喻，近江君全不理解。

en.t: Omi no Kimi did not understand this humorous bit of sarcasm at all.

units.source_text: 这位内大臣在许多同辈之中，仪容最为清秀堂皇，光彩逼人，可使凡夫俗子望而却步，但近江君不能赏识。

en.t: Among all his peers, this Minister of the Interior was the most refined and imposing in appearance, with a radiance that could make ordinary people shrink back, but Omi no Kimi could not appreciate it.

units.source_text: 她接着说：“那么我几时去见女御呢？”

en.t: She went on, "Then when should I go to see the consort?"

units.source_text: 内大臣答道：“照理应当选个好日子。

en.t: The Minister of the Interior replied, "Properly speaking, one ought to choose an auspicious day.

units.source_text: 但不选也罢，何必大肆铺张呢？

en.t: But it would be fine not to choose one. Why make such a grand affair of it?

units.source_text: 你倘想去，就在今天去也好。”

en.t: If you wish to go, you may as well go today."

units.source_text: 内大臣说过之后就回去了。

en.t: After saying this, the Minister of the Interior went away.
